description: Local-first mode using SQLite WASM + OPFS in the browser. Per-device opt-in syncs feed subscriptions, items, and read/starred state to a local SQLite database; an optional second toggle stores article content locally. Last-write-wins conflict resolution on `updated_at`, with the Cloudflare Durable Object as the merge point. Falls back transparently to the existing remote adapter on browsers without OPFS support.

`src/server/durable-objects/index.ts` imports and executes the shared schema instead of inline strings; no behavior change

userStories.title: Add LWW conflict resolution to server mutating endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need server endpoints to reject stale writes by comparing `client_updated_at` against the row's current `updated_at`, so multi-device edits converge correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /api/items/:id, POST /api/feeds, DELETE /api/feeds/:id, and POST /api/items/mark-all-read accept an optional `client_updated_at` field in the JSON body
When `client_updated_at` is present and the row's current `updated_at > client_updated_at`, respond 409 with the authoritative current row(s) in the body
When `client_updated_at` is absent, behavior is unchanged (back-compat for existing clients)
New tests in `test/db-adapter.ts` (or a new `test/server-lww.ts`) cover: stale write rejected, fresh write accepted, missing field uses old behavior

userStories.title: Implement pull-sync (server -> local)
userStories.description: As a user, I want my local DB to receive changes the server has made since my last sync.
acceptanceCriteria: New module `src/client/db/pull-sync.ts` exports `async function pullSync()` that calls `/api/sync?since=<lastPullAt>` and upserts returned feeds and items into the local DB
`lastPullAt` is read/written from a `sync_meta` single-row table; first call (no row) omits `since` and treats response as a full snapshot
When `storeContent.value === false`, item upserts store `NULL` for `content` and `description`
Hooked to run on app startup when authenticated and `getAdapter()` returned `localAdapter`, and on the window `online` event

userStories.title: Implement push-sync drain
userStories.description: As a user, I want my offline edits to upload to the server once I'm back online, with sane handling of conflicts and auth failures.
acceptanceCriteria: New module `src/client/db/push-sync.ts` exports `async function pushSync()` that reads outbox rows in `id` order and calls the matching backend endpoint with `client_updated_at` and `client_op_id` in the body
On 2xx: delete the outbox row
On 5xx or network error: increment `attempts` and `last_error`; row remains for next cycle
On 409 (LWW conflict from US-002): upsert the server's authoritative row into the local DB and delete the outbox row
On 401: halt drain and surface to the auth flow; outbox preserved
Push runs after every successful pull and on the `online` event
Tests cover happy path, 5xx retry, 409 reconciliation, and 401 halt
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
